selected_observations.excerpt:
Counterparty: Oakfield Logistics GmbH
Effective: 1 September 2018
Term: rolling 12-month periods.
This agreement is silent on change of control.

selection_rationale: CoC termination right must be read from MSA-OAK-2018 change-of-control provisions.
known_missing_information: Contracts with only consent requirements (Helion) lack explicit termination-on-CoC language.
